description: Tasks against the real temporalio/temporal AGENTS.md. Tasks authored by us (disclosed); rules and checkers anchor to verbatim file text. No task mentions the rule it tests.

In a Go test for this repo, assert that computedScore (a float64) is approximately 0.75. Show the assertion line.
Inside one of this repo's functional test suites, assert that err from CreateNamespace is nil. Show the assertion line.
You edited proto/internal/workflow.proto. What command do you run next?
Your Go change to the matching service compiles and its tests pass. What do you run before finishing up?
